text:
Lina: Quick heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 to consolidate the 'first run' quickstart (node + py) into one UX flow. Need reviews, link fixes, and auth snippet sync.
Sam: Taking a look now. Major diff?
Lina: Mostly reorganizing steps: env setup, auth, single deploy flow. Snippets updated for SDK v5 (node) and SDK 4->5 migration note. Also replaced some raw curl examples with SDK calls.
Priya: Can you paste the new Node snippet? I want to verify token handling.
Lina: Sure —
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [...] });
console.log(res.choices[0].message);
```
Sam: Looks fine. Need to add note about env var export for mac/linux:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx
```
Omar: CI failed on docs build (linkcheck) — broken link in old /examples/hello-ts. I can fix and push a small patch.
DocsBot: build/docs — Linkcheck failed in /quickstart/hello-world.md — 404: /examples/hello-ts (build #823)
Lina: Thanks Omar — if you fix that, can you also update the cross-ref to the migration guide? I added a new section 'Auth migration (SDK v4 -> v5)'.
Omar: Yep, will do. Also flagging one more: Python snippet still uses legacy `client.generate`. I can PR the change.
Ben: I can run the staging walkthrough on Monday and validate the deploy steps (GCP region + Dedicated testing note).
Priya: I'm happy to do a link sweep + internal docs checklist (readme badges, quickstart TOC) — will mark items in the PR.
Sam: Quick ask — should we keep the curl example at the end for debugging? Some folks still prefer it.
Lina: Yes, keep a brief curl example and label it 'low-level debug only'.
Priya: +1
Ben: LGTM once CI passes and Omar's fixes land.
Lina: Great — assigning reviewers: @Sam, @Priya, @Ben. Omar to push the link & python fixes. I'll re-run the staging guide after merges. Thanks all! :tada:
